remarks: Turnkey two-bedroom, two-bath townhouse in Riverside Walk puts you in the heart of Westport. Walk to Starbucks, Bedford Square dining, Main Street shops, and summer concerts at the Levitt Pavilion. A private elevator brings you from your reserved garage space to bright single-level living with ceilings over nine feet high on both floors and hardwood throughout. The white kitchen offers granite counters, stainless appliances, a large walk-in pantry, and a dining area that opens to an oversized bluestone patio for easy indoor-outdoor entertaining. The generous primary suite includes a walk-in closet. The second bedroom enjoys calming Saugatuck River views, perfect for guests or a home office. Recent upgrades include a brand-new water heater plus a new full-size washer and dryer, giving you worry-free comfort.  Minutes to Metro-North, Compo Beach, and all Westport amenities. Garage elevator exits at the same level as the front doors, allowing step-free access.
